# service shutdown date

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:serviceShutdownDate`](gmeow-serviceShutdownDate.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/serviceShutdownDate>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/accounts`](../../slices/accounts.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The date a historical online service shut down (Yahoo 360: 2009-07-13). The flat shortcut for service liveness; projects to [schema:dissolutionDate.](https://schema.org/dissolutionDate.) Promote to a destruction [`LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md) when evidence/standpoint matters.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:serviceShutdownDate`](gmeow-serviceShutdownDate.md) from [`gmeow:OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md) to [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record when a historical online service ceased operation — the flat shutdown date that keeps a defunct service (Yahoo 360, Google+) first-class with its end recorded rather than deleted (P10).

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the shutdown carries evidence, dispute, or standpoint that must be first-class — promote to a destruction [`LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md) (lifecycle slice) — and avoid using it for an account's own retirement (use [`gmeow:accountStatus`](gmeow-accountStatus.md) historical).

### How to use

- Carry the date as an [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) on the [`OnlineService`](../classes/gmeow-OnlineService.md) and set [`gmeow:serviceStatus`](gmeow-serviceStatus.md) to [`gmeow:serviceStatusShutDown`](../individuals/gmeow-serviceStatusShutDown.md); the flat date projects to [schema:dissolutionDate](https://schema.org/dissolutionDate), and you reify to a [`LifeEvent`](../classes/gmeow-LifeEvent.md) only when provenance demands it.

### Examples

- ex:yahoo360 [`gmeow:serviceShutdownDate`](gmeow-serviceShutdownDate.md) "2009-07-13T00:00:00"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
